quarterly_data.quarter: Murata press release: Murata Develops 6G Antenna Module for Frequencies Above 100 (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Murata developed an antenna module for the D-band (110 to 170 GHz) expected to be used in 6G, through joint research with imec, combining its proprietary LTCC substrate (in-house ceramic material optimized for low dielectric constant and low dielectric loss tangent) with an imec D-band beamforming IC. Communication evaluation verified wireless communication at 135 GHz, signal transmission using bandwidths of up to 8 GHz and two-dimensional beam control for both transmission and reception; Murata calls it the world's first LTCC antenna module to support D-band operation and two-dimensional beam control for both transmission and reception (based on its own survey as of October 4, 2026). This is a development result, not a product launch: Murata will advance technology development toward practical use and volume production, targeting commercialization from 2030 onward.
quarterly_data.figure: 135 GHz; bandwidths of up to 8 GHz; D-band 110 to 170 GHz; commercialization targeted from 2030 onward
